# EmotionsMap

> EmotionsMap is a free mood tracker app for iOS and Android. Log your daily mood with one tap on a visual grid inspired by GitHub's contribution graph ("year in pixels"), write journal entries, and discover emotional patterns over time. 100% private: all data stays on the device (local SQLite), no account required, works fully offline.

EmotionsMap is designed for people who want a simple, private way to track their emotional wellbeing without cloud sync, sign-ups, or data collection. Available in English and Spanish.

## Key facts

- Price: free to download and use (iOS App Store and Google Play)
- Platforms: iPhone (iOS) and Android
- Privacy: all data stored locally on the device in SQLite; nothing is uploaded to any server; no account, email, or phone number required; no data is sold or shared with third parties
- Offline: works 100% offline after the initial download
- Languages: English and Spanish

## Features

- Monthly mosaic: each month as a colorful grid where every cell is a day painted with your mood (Excellent, Good, Neutral, Difficult, Bad)
- Year in pixels: 365 days of moods on a single screen
- Journal with search: write daily reflections and search through them
- Word cloud: most-used words from your journal, colored by the average mood associated with each word, computed locally on the device
- Statistics: mood distribution, streaks, most productive month
- PIN lock: protect the journal with a PIN
- Export and import: full history as JSON backup, or share images of your year/month

## FAQ

- Is EmotionsMap free? Yes, free to download and use; all core features are available from day one.
- Is my data safe? Data is stored locally on the device in an encrypted SQLite database; nothing is uploaded to any server; the app can be locked with a PIN.
- Can I export my data? Yes, the full history can be exported as JSON, and the year or a month can be exported as an image.
- Does it need internet? No, it works 100% offline; internet is only needed for the initial download.
